gloss: edge of a body of water; shore; bank

definitions.gloss: edge of a body of water; shore; bank; lakeside
definitions.explanation: The area immediately beside a lake, river, pond, or sea. A somewhat literary word, often used in descriptive or poetic writing rather than casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っていた→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A small house stood on the riverbank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent a quiet afternoon reading a book by the pond.

notes:
A literary word for the edge of a body of water, typically combined with the body of water using ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}: lakeside
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}: riverbank
- ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}: pond's edge
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{畔|ほとり}: seashore (less common; ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧ is more usual)

REGISTER:
{畔|ほとり} has a literary, slightly poetic feel. In ordinary speech, more concrete words are preferred:
- ⟦{湖畔|こはん}→湖畔：17526_kohan⟧: lakeside (formal/written compound)
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧ / ⟦{川辺|かわべ}→川辺：20224_kawabe⟧: riverbank (everyday)
- ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧: seaside (everyday)
